transitions.statement: Validation ladder: MATE - scientific development and validation -> MVCRI - cross-country transferability -> AgroVIR farmer field - operational transferability -> DrR Web MVP - research-to-operation delivery.

outcomes.statement: A physiologically defined water-stress target and a Sentinel-2-transferable early-warning feature basis, replacing spectral-proxy stress definitions.
outcomes.note: Derived: transitions TR1/TR2 state the intended change of state, and D1.1/D1.2/D2.1/D2.2 are the outputs whose content (harmonised data, physiological target, transfer library) brings that state about. The draft states both ends but not the output->outcome link.

outcomes.statement: A prospective, uncertainty-aware stress-forecasting capability at actionable horizons, in place of static detection.
outcomes.note: Derived: TR3 names the static-to-prospective transition; D3.1/D3.2 (modelling benchmark, predictive engine with model card) are the outputs that realise it. Link inferred, not stated.

outcomes.statement: Quantified temporal and Hungary-to-Bulgaria transferability of the predictive model, with a stated local-calibration cost for adapting it to a new agro-environment.
outcomes.note: Derived: TR4/TR5 name the transferability transitions; D4.1-D4.3 are the benchmark, report and protocol that quantify them. Link inferred, not stated.

outcomes.statement: Evidence of field-level decision value under commercial farming conditions, enabling model selection by usefulness rather than retrospective accuracy.
outcomes.note: Derived: TR6 names the accuracy-to-decision-value transition; D5.2-D5.4 (commercial-field assessment, FDV report, AgroVIR evaluation) are the outputs that evidence it. Link inferred, not stated.

outcomes.statement: A research-to-operation delivery path: an externally evaluated web MVP and a named post-MSCA FMIS integration route.
outcomes.note: Derived from the validation ladder's final rung and D5.1/D5.5. The draft itself bounds this outcome: the MVP is the research-to-operation demonstrator, not the primary scientific objective (¶158), and full commercial integration is not promised within the fellowship (¶170).

outcomes.statement: A researcher profile combining biological understanding, scalable geospatial prediction and operational decision support, carried by an agreed and reviewed Career Development Plan.
outcomes.note: Derived: §2.1 states the career outcome and §1.4 the intended progression; D1.3 (operator-added, item 6) is the output that carries them. The draft states the career claims but assembles no plan and names no deliverable for them.
